author: opencode-worker-7
text: Reviewer evidence while converging python RREQ receiver policy (b7z9.194): C parse path does not validate/clamp wire hop_limit > MAX_HOP_LIMIT before the cost subtraction at lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/loadng.c:661 (MIN(MAX-hop_limit,255) wraps into a nonsense metric for garbage bytes), while python rejects out-of-range at from_bytes and at the process_rreq handler. Python is the defensive side; this bead's C-side validation is the fix.
